system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:44 UTC, ivy.chen ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-NWD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon then recorded creation of that archive.
Edge was launched by ivy.chen to open quickshare-drop.net, a service not listed among the organization’s approved services.
The proxy recorded a 51,000,000-byte client-to-server transfer to quickshare-drop.net over a 14.9-second tunnel, and network telemetry attributes the proxy connection to Edge running as ivy.chen.
The sequence of archiving client-share data followed shortly by a large outbound transfer to an unapproved file-sharing service strongly indicates data exfiltration.
A user-level executable named KB5034441_update.exe was later run from C:\Windows\Temp with a quiet argument; the available records do not establish that it was an authorized patch.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy CONNECT tunnel and connection byte counts show transfer volume but do not reveal the encrypted request contents or uploaded filename.
The logs show creation of c.zip before the transfer, but do not directly establish that this specific archive was uploaded.
The provided records do not include file contents, hashes, or endpoint telemetry showing the browser's file-selection or upload actions.
claims_not_established: The exact contents of c.zip and whether all or any of the archived client data was transmitted.
Who initiated or authorized the transfer, or whether ivy.chen was acting knowingly.
Whether KB5034441_update.exe was malicious or related to the outbound transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and inspect c.zip and relevant source files; collect file metadata and hashes.
Obtain endpoint browser/download/upload artifacts and process/file-access telemetry to confirm which file was uploaded.
Review proxy, DNS, and network-security records for destination resolution, reputation, and any related connections.
Acquire and analyze KB5034441_update.exe, including its hash, signature status, origin, and execution effects.
Interview ivy.chen and check approved business activity or authorization for transferring client data.
